prompt.project_info: An ultra-photorealistic soft-glam romantic fashion editorial on a rustic outdoor terrace.
prompt.main_subject: An adult blonde woman with fair warm-undertone skin, long loose side-parted hair, natural soft-glam makeup, rosy blush, soft pink lips, light mascara, and a gentle confident smile. She wears a soft blush-pink lace corset-style fashion romper with an opaque lining, structured corset seams, thin straps, scalloped lace trim, and a light layered tulle accent at the hips. The form-fitting fashion silhouette complements her feminine figure.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 4:5 mid-thigh portrait, centered with a slight right offset. She sits poised on a terrace ledge with legs naturally crossed, one hand resting on the surface and the other lightly holding her hair. Retain sunlit green foliage, wooden roof beams, and soft landscape blur; omit text, logos, and watermarks.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Large open-window daylight side-lights the scene with warm golden diffused sunlight. Gentle highlights and subtle shadows create depth; sunlight highlights shoulders and chest area while realistic shadows enhance the outfit's silhouette. Keep a warm serene European-summer ambiance.
prompt.technical_specs: Full-frame DSLR, 85mm f/1.4 portrait lens at f/1.8, 1/200s, ISO 100, sharp focus on face and upper torso, shallow cinematic background separation, warm pastel grade, subtle vignette and very light film grain, 8K UHD.
